summary.text: Catherine "Barcy" Whitson is an independent candidate for U.S. Senate in Tennessee. According to her campaign website, she had a career in the insurance industry and has spent about 20 years as a volunteer life coach, pastor and mentor.

paragraphs.text: Whitson goes by Barcy and says she is running for the 2027-2033 term to promote "What Tennesseans Want."
She is on the November 3, 2026 ballot as an independent.
